purpose: Infrastructure test of the trading node on a second market (Hong Kong paper account, Hong Kong hours). Not a validated edge: the 18 Oct 2026 Hong Kong search found nothing fit to trade, and this strategy's pass is consistent with luck across its family (White's Reality Check p = 0.79 under config A, 0.46 under config B).
rationale: Grid-searched the most recent training segment by Sharpe, the same procedure each walk-forward window uses and the US forward test used.
capital_rationale: HK$100,000 of the Hong Kong paper account, as the earlier Hong Kong paper test. HSBC trades in board lots of 400 shares (about HK$60,000 at HK$150), so the strategy holds one lot; the node rounds buys down to the lot.
